title: Sadaat e Karbala
body:
Sadaat e Karbala
Sadaat e karbala x 2
<<DIVIDER>>
Chehlum ko karbala me jab aayi wo bibiyaa
<<MINI>>
Sadaat e karbala..
<<DIVIDER>>
Har bibi kar rahi thi kuch is tarha se girya
<<MINI>>
Sadaat e karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
1.kuch bibiya yaha hai kuch bibiya waha
Karti hui fugaa x 2
Bikhri hui thi maqtal e sarwar me jaa bajaa
2.Ek bibi dasht e khuni me jaati hai nahr par
<<DIVIDER>>
Kehti ba chashme tar x2
Abbas dene aayi hoon pursa sakina ka.
3.Ghut ghutke laadli teri zinda mein mar gayi
Turbat wahi bani x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Bhaiyya wo qaid se na hui marke bhi juda.
4.Akbar ki kabr par yoooo hui laila nauhagar
Dekha na saalbhar x 2
Aayi hoo kaid e shaam se ab hoke mai riha.
<<DIVIDER>>
5.Bano ye bain karti thi aie mere bezubaan
Maa dhoonde ab kahaa x2
Batla de hai kahaa mera asgar aie karbala.
6.Qurban tere aie mere maajaaye bewatan, Majboor thi bahen x 2
<<DIVIDER>>
Zindaa me mujhse teri amanat hui juda.
7.Rote hai khaas o aam tera sunke ye kalaam
Aie shaah k gulaam x 2
Nauha tera anees hai makbool e baargaah
